definitions.ask: Open the reading task without showing Bob Refs when the focused PDF resolves cleanly?
definitions.why: Showing Refs only to vanish when Obsidian takes focus adds nothing; failures still land on Tabs

choices.label: Obsidian jumps straight to the task; Bob Refs appears only when the task can't open
Bob Refs flashes up in Tabs, then the task opens exactly as ⌘T then ⌃↩ would
